# Agent HUD 0.4.39-beta.2
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- Improves LAN snapshot updates by computing canonical record IDs once before sorting snapshots and replay batches. This removes repeated encoding from the sorting hot path. - Recognises personal SuperGrok accounts whose native Grok Bot usage records contain both a user principal and a team ID. The account can now display its confirmed weekly quota. - Leaves Codex automatic approval review to Codex. The HUD only handles a permission request when the matching turn explicitly uses a user reviewer. - Includes the LAN connection and cross-device sync fixes from the 0.4.39 release series.
## Known issues
- Grok prepaid and on-demand wallet amounts, including a zero-dollar wallet, are not yet displayed. The missing-quota placeholder also remains outstanding. [Issue #20](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/issues/20) remains open; [PR #35](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/pull/35) and [PR #38](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/pull/38) address native usage reading and personal-account recognition. - Cross-device features require iPhone 1.5 or later. Use the corresponding TestFlight build while version 1.5 is awaiting App Store review.

# Agent HUD 0.5.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- Adds Separate agents for Simple and Dynamic modes, off by default in Display settings. Hovering an agent's logo shows a small card with that agent's quota, tokens and sessions beside it, and a click opens that agent's whole panel. Replies and permission requests open beside the agent that sent them while the other logos stay. - Grows a Simple panel itself into the usage panel on hover instead of fading a separate panel over it, and gives Simple its own Bot animation switch, off by default. Display settings lists the modes as Notch, Simple and Dynamic. - Opens permission and reply reminders as the agent's logo, which turns into its bot once the card has opened. - Shows Codex Desktop's mid-turn Question cards on the HUD, including questions with only a reply field. Answers go to the original turn; Skip leaves the question unanswered. - Notices a Codex turn that starts in a quiet session within five seconds instead of up to five minutes. - Picks the HUD up after a short drag or hold instead of on mouse down, keeps the closed hand for the whole drag, and outlines a Simple panel's own shape while it moves. - Uses less CPU while agents work: bots are stepped only as often as they move, local services are looked for every 10 seconds instead of every 2, and a collection pass no longer repeats work for records that did not change. - Reads quota and balance less often: every 2.5 to 3.5 minutes while a turn runs instead of every minute, and every 5 to 6 minutes between turns. Scheduled readings wait a random time of up to a minute, so Macs on accounts that reset together do not ask a service in the same second. The reading after a turn ends, and the one opening the panel asks for, are immediate as before. - Sends iCloud one batch every five minutes instead of every change, which ends the hours-long refusals some Macs ran into. Events, permission requests and prompt results still go at once, and an iPhone on the same network still follows every change. - Adds an Experimental settings page with one Remote Sessions switch for Claude Code and Codex: answer permission requests and continue a session from the iPhone. It needs Agent HUD for iPhone 1.6, which is not on the App Store yet. [Guide](https://agenthud.app/guides/remote-sessions).
